text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Final touches completed in the area of Toshka before President Hosni Mubarak gives the go-ahead signal to the next century's project.

- Mubarak receives a report on the Egyptian delegation's mission in Gaza to help formulate the Hebron areement. The five-day visit by the delegation aimed at helping the Palestinian Authority formulate the legal aspect of the agreement.

- Presidential adviser Osama el-Baz says "It has not been proved that the letters bombs, received in the United States, were sent from Egypt. The U.S. ambassador in Cairo, after a meeting with Baz, denied the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) sent an investigation team.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says the Palestinian-Israeli negotiations have not achieved progress.
